current.name: Distribution / Post-Peak Deleveraging
current.rationale: Early distribution — price near highs while breadth, leadership and follow-through quietly deteriorate.

regimes.name: Structural Shock / Crisis
regimes.description: An exceptional market-wide disruption caused by macro news, exchange failure, protocol exploit, depeg, geopolitical shock or a major liquidation event. An emergency override rather than a normal cycle stage.

regimes.name: Established Bear Market
regimes.description: A sustained declining market with lower highs, lower lows, weak breadth and failing rallies.

regimes.name: Capitulation / Bear Exhaustion
regimes.description: The late, violent stage of a bear market, characterised by forced selling, extreme volatility and large liquidation events.

regimes.name: Bottoming / Accumulation
regimes.description: Selling pressure has weakened and the market is forming a base, but no durable positive trend has been confirmed.

regimes.name: Early Recovery
regimes.description: Major assets begin reclaiming trend levels, making higher lows and attracting new capital, but false recoveries remain possible.

regimes.name: BTC-Led Bull Market
regimes.description: BTC is in a confirmed uptrend and receives most of the new capital while ETH and the broader alt market lag.

regimes.name: Broadening Bull Market
regimes.description: Leadership expands from BTC into ETH, SOL, large-cap alts and major sectors.

regimes.name: Broad Bull / Alt Expansion
regimes.description: A broad range of large-, mid- and selected lower-cap assets trend upward. Breadth and market participation are strong.

regimes.name: Speculative Euphoria
regimes.description: Altcoins, memes and low-cap assets lead; leverage, funding, attention and retail participation become excessive. An internal euphoria_score separates an ordinary alt expansion from a terminal blow-off.

regimes.name: Distribution / Post-Peak Deleveraging
regimes.description: Market breadth deteriorates, breakouts fail, alts begin falling faster than BTC and leveraged positions are unwound. Exposes an internal stage from early_distribution to active_deleveraging.
